snippet.title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Developer Exkee has announced Rescue Ops: Wildfire, an immersive and dynamic firefighter simulation game. With realistic and unpredictable wildfire behavior, an authentic fleet of vehicles to operate, and thrilling front-line firefighting gameplay, simulation game fans are in for a treat when the game launches in Early Access on Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox PC in late 2025. 

* Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915770/Rescue_Ops_Wildfire/
* Epic Games Store page: https://store.epicgames.com/fr/p/wildfire-eb8e7f 
* Xbox Store page (PC only): https://www.xbox.com/games/store/rescue-ops-wildfire/9phfmrcfvvrf
* Follow us: https://linktr.ee/rescueops_game 

Rescue Ops: Wildfire
Reveal Trailer - (c) Exkee - May 2025
